description: This file contains benchmark functions for the Cell_ECM class, performing various battery simulation tests with different configurations and parameters.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_single_default_pulse
methods.description: Runs a battery benchmark with default parameters on a Cell_ECM instance, performing charge/discharge cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_single_default_CCCV
methods.description: Runs a battery benchmark with default parameters on a Cell_ECM instance, performing CCCV charge cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_2_RC_single_default_pulse
methods.description: Runs a benchmark on a 2-contact resistance Cell_ECM with default pulse cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_2_RC_single_default_CCCV
methods.description: Runs a CCCV cycle benchmark on a 2-contact resistance Cell_ECM.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_parallel_3_default_pulse
methods.description: Performs a parallel 3-cell Cell_ECM benchmark with default pulse cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_parallel_3_default_CCCV
methods.description: Performs a parallel 3-cell Cell_ECM benchmark with default CCCV cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_parallel_3_withRcontact_CCCV
methods.description: Runs a parallel 3-cell Cell_ECM with additional contact resistances, performing CCCV cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_series_3_withRcontact_CCCV
methods.description: Runs a series 3-cell Cell_ECM with contact resistances, performing CCCV cycles.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_SmallPack
methods.description: Simulates a small pack of Cell_ECM batteries performing a charge cycle.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_MediumPack
methods.description: Simulates a medium pack of Cell_ECM batteries with multiple modules and performs a charge cycle.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_LargePack
methods.description: Simulates a large pack of Cell_ECM batteries with many modules and performs a charge cycle.

methods.name: run_Cell_ECM_LargePackLong
methods.description: Simulates a large pack with extended cycles and rest periods, testing long-term performance.
